# NetCDF export

Back to the [API overview](../API.md) · [README](../../README.md) · [usage guide](../USAGE.md) · [parameter reference](../PARAMETERS.md).

`amgeo_sd.export` — Scans to an xarray Dataset / `.pp.nc`, run provenance files.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`output_dir`](#output_dir) | ``<base>/<sim_id>/<rad>/`` (created), the legacy output layout. |
| [`save_run_metadata`](#save_run_metadata) | Write ``script.cmd`` (the command line) and ``params.toml`` (annotated parameters) into ``out_dir``. |
| [`scans_to_dataset`](#scans_to_dataset) | Pack filtered scans and range-cell geometry into the fitacf++ dataset. |
| [`write_netcdf`](#write_netcdf) | Write ``ds`` as NetCDF4 with zlib compression on every numeric variable. |

## `output_dir`

```python
output_dir(base: str | os.PathLike, sim_id: str, rad: str) -> Path
```

``<base>/<sim_id>/<rad>/`` (created), the legacy output layout.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | str or path | required | Base output directory (``[run] out``). |
| `sim_id` | str | required | Run name (``[run] sim_id``). |
| `rad` | str | required | Radar code. |

**Returns**

- *Path* — The directory, created if needed.

## `save_run_metadata`

```python
save_run_metadata(argv: Sequence[str], params_toml: str, out_dir: str | os.PathLike) -> None
```

Write ``script.cmd`` (the command line) and ``params.toml`` (annotated parameters) into ``out_dir``.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `argv` | sequence of str | required | The command line of the run (``sys.argv``). |
| `params_toml` | str | required | Text of ``params.toml``, normally from [`dump_settings_toml`](config.md#dump_settings_toml). |
| `out_dir` | str or path | required | Existing output directory. |

## `scans_to_dataset`

```python
scans_to_dataset(scans: Sequence[Scan], fov: dict, attrs: dict | None = None) -> xr.Dataset
```

Pack filtered scans and range-cell geometry into the fitacf++ dataset.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scans` | sequence of Scan | required | Output of a filter; ``Beam.extra`` entries listed in `EXTRA_FIELDS` are written when present. |
| `fov` | dict | required | Result of [`radar_fov`](geo.md#radar_fov) (needs ``glat``, ``glon``, ``beams``, ``gates``; ``gazm`` optional). |
| `attrs` | dict, optional | `None` | Global attributes; values are made NetCDF safe (bool -> int, datetime -> ISO string, None -> ""). |

**Returns**

- *xarray.Dataset* — Dimensions ``scan_num``, ``sound`` (beam slot within a scan), ``beams`` (nbeams + 1) and ``gates`` (ngates + 1). ``gdlat``, ``gdlon``, ``gdazm`` (beams, gates) hold the range-cell corner geolocation; per-beam variables (``bmnum``, ``tfreq``, ``noise.sky``, ``scan``, ``nrang``, ``frang``, ``rsep``, ``time``, ``mppul``, ``intt.us``, ``intt.sc``) have shape (scan_num, sound); per-echo variables (``v``, ``w_l``, ``p_l``, ``gflg`` and the extras ``gflg_conv``, ``gflg_kde``, ``v_mad``, ``clabel``, ``cluster_tag``, ``gflg_ribiero`` that the beams carry) have shape (scan_num, sound, gates), NaN where there is no echo.

**Raises**

- *ValueError* — When ``scans`` is empty or an echo lies outside the radar's range gates.

## `write_netcdf`

```python
write_netcdf(ds: xr.Dataset, path: str | os.PathLike, complevel: int = 4) -> Path
```

Write ``ds`` as NetCDF4 with zlib compression on every numeric variable.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ds` | xarray.Dataset | required | Dataset from [`scans_to_dataset`](export.md#scans_to_dataset). |
| `path` | str or path | required | Output file (``<rad>_<start>_<end>.pp.nc``); parent directories are created. |
| `complevel` | int | `4` | zlib compression level, 1 (fast) to 9 (small). |

**Returns**

- *Path* — The file written.
